findings.detail: model_stage releases its publication fence in a finally block even when a model request becomes sent or uncertain. A subsequent protected ABORT_AND_INVALIDATE cannot find that fence, so the documented recovery path cannot persist invalidation before releasing it. The unresolved ledger operation still blocks further model calls, but it does not preserve the claimed recovery state.
findings.required_fix: Keep the fence when transmission or checkpoint outcome is unresolved. Release it only after a safely settled and checkpointed stage, or through the protected invalidation procedure. Test a real model-stage timeout and interrupted checkpoint, including recovery and a concurrent Research start.

findings.detail: The live-site gate treats agreement among a sitemap, three index pages and a homepage count as a complete site inventory. It silently excludes other URL patterns and cannot detect an existing article omitted from all three discovery sources. Consequently, the dedup receipt can assert sufficient live coverage without evidence covering such pages.
findings.required_fix: Establish and record a defensible target-site inventory covering all relevant article routes, including orphaned or non-sitemap pages where applicable. Return a coverage hold when completeness cannot be established, and test a duplicate absent from both sitemap and captured indexes.

cloud-pilot-manual.yml.content:
name: AutoBridge multilingual API pilot
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: Offline inspection or separately approved real execution
        type: choice
        options: [preflight, account-check, audit, execute]
        default: preflight
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: autobridge-entire-real-pilot-program
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  trusted:
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    uses: xysjou/AutoBridge-Content-Pipeline/.github/workflows/cloud-pilot-trusted.yml@b3f5a6cef20b8dc235f001af306e635f1eca0fdf
    with:
      mode: ${{ inputs.mode }}
    secrets:
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
      AUTOBRIDGE_CONTROL_COMMIT: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_CONTROL_COMMIT }}
      AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256 }}

cloud-pilot-trusted.yml.content:
name: AutoBridge pinned protected runtime
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      mode:
        type: string
        required: true
    secrets:
      OPENAI_API_KEY:
        required: true
      AUTOBRIDGE_CONTROL_COMMIT:
        required: true
      AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256:
        required: true
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  inspect:
    if: inputs.mode == 'preflight'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - run: python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual preflight
  account-check:
    # Availability is inspected inside the code/lease-preauthorized execute path.
    # Disable the legacy standalone key-bearing path permanently.
    if: ${{ false }}
    environment: autobridge-pilot
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Inspect only the two configured model metadata endpoints
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_ACCOUNT_CHECK_APPROVED: 'true'
        run: python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual account-check
  execute:
    if: >-
      (inputs.mode == 'execute' || inputs.mode == 'audit') &&
      vars.AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_ENABLED == 'true' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/integration/work-cloud-pilot-m1-20261102'
    environment: autobridge-pilot
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 180
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Fetch reviewed control documents from a separate immutable commit
        env:
          AUTOBRIDGE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVAL_COMMIT: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_CONTROL_COMMIT }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA }}
        run: python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual.control
      - name: Validate exact run and workflow lease before exposing the project key
        env:
          AUTOBRIDGE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256 }}
        run: >-
          python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual preauthorize
          --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-plan.json"
          --prices "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-prices.json"
          --permit "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-permit.json"
      - name: Execute approved phase with the existing whole-program budget
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256 }}
          APPROVED_RUN_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
        run: >-
          python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual "$APPROVED_RUN_MODE"
          --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-plan.json"
          --prices "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-prices.json"
          --permit "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-permit.json"

articles.reason: The repository’s Changan CS75 PLUS page concerns a different model, generation and year. The live SUV-shortlist guides address broad, destination-dependent selection methods, not whether this specific China-market X5 PLUS configuration should be shortlisted. The proposed article has a distinct model-specific recommendation intent. Keep its model identity and recommendation limited to the evidence-matched 2026 second-generation 1.5T reference; topic distinction does not verify availability, export suitability or any final specification.

The Foton Aumark article is principally a vehicle/build procurement guide, separating chassis, insulated body and refrigeration unit; fleet procurement covers broader specification and tender controls; and PDI/shipping content addresses general condition and handover. The proposed guide targets a different downstream decision: how parties document acceptance of a completed refrigerated truck against agreed cargo, operating conditions, sensor records, door-opening pattern, power modes and responsibilities. Preserve that acceptance-evidence scope and avoid repeating general reefer selection or generic PDI advice. The cited method and manufacturer materials do not by themselves establish universal acceptance thresholds or requirements.
